license_note: No LICENSE file ships in the weight repository; the gated card links the Mistral Research License as the governing terms. The MRL grants use, copying, modification, and distribution but limits all use of the model, derivatives, and outputs to non-profit, non-commercial research purposes, with commercial use requiring a separate license from Mistral AI, so the release is source-available rather than open source.

access_boundary: This record represents the mistralai/Mistral-Large-Instruct-2411 weight release of November 2024 at Hugging Face commit ba78820945ae22361b0274cf0ae6d696c967c1a4 (last modified 2025-07-28), together with the mistral-large-2411 API model and its Vertex AI and GitHub Models hosting. Later Large generations, the Pixtral releases of the same announcement, and community quantizations remain separate boundaries.
